##### Litter data analysis

```{r litter-chem, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hold', echo=FALSE}
litter_chem <- read.table(here::here("litter_chem/litter_chem.txt"),
                          header = T, sep = "\t", comment.char = "")

litter_chem <- litter_chem |>
  dplyr::select(-c(1:4, 6:10)) |>
  mutate(sampleID = gsub("^#\\d+\\s+", "", desc_1)) |>
  dplyr::select(-desc_1) |>
  dplyr::select(sampleID, everything()) |>
  filter(sampleID != "SKIP")

litter_chem <- litter_chem |>
  mutate(
    new_sampleID = case_when(
      grepl("1$", sampleID) ~ sub("1$", "3", sampleID),
      grepl("2$", sampleID) ~ sub("2$", "4", sampleID),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(new_sampleID)) |>
  bind_rows(
    litter_chem |>
      mutate(
        sampleID = case_when(
          grepl("1$", sampleID) ~ sub("1$", "3", sampleID),
          grepl("2$", sampleID) ~ sub("2$", "4", sampleID),
          TRUE ~ sampleID
        )
      )
  ) |>
  arrange(sampleID) %>%
  dplyr::select(sampleID, ADF, NDF, CP, Lignin, NFC, NSC) %>%
  mutate(
    cellulose              = ADF - Lignin,
    hemicellulose          = NDF - ADF,
    hemicellulose          = pmax(hemicellulose, 0),
    Structural_Carbohydrates = NFC - NSC
  ) %>%
  filter(!sampleID %in% c("0.1", "0.3", "#97")) %>%
  dplyr::select(sampleID, CP, cellulose, hemicellulose, Structural_Carbohydrates, Lignin) |>
  dplyr::rename(lignin = Lignin, crude_protein = CP)

# Merge litter chemistry with metadata
metadata <- merge(metadata, litter_chem, by.x = "SampleID", by.y = "sampleID", all.x = T)
metadata <- column_to_rownames(metadata, var = "SampleID")

# PCA on all samples
pca_litt <- prcomp(~ pH + crude_protein + cellulose + hemicellulose + lignin,
                   data = metadata[, c(11, 15:19)], center = T, scale. = T, na.action = na.exclude)
summary(pca_litt)

pca_litt_sq_loadings   <- pca_litt$rotation^2
pca_litt_contributions <- sweep(pca_litt_sq_loadings, 2, colSums(pca_litt_sq_loadings), FUN = "/") * 100
print(pca_litt_contributions)

pca_litt_contributions <- as.data.frame(pca_litt_contributions) |>
  rownames_to_column(var = "Variable") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:6), names_to = "PC", values_to = "Percent")

pca_litt_contributions_plot <- pca_litt_contributions |>
  filter(PC %in% c("PC1", "PC2")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC, y = Percent, fill = Variable)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#8B4513", "#D2691E", "#F4A460", "#FFD700", "black")) +
  labs(y = "% of variance contribution") +
  apatheme +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())

pca_litt_contributions_plot

pca_litt_df      <- data.frame(pca_litt$x)
pca_litt_df      <- merge(pca_litt_df, metadata, by = "row.names", all.x = T)
PCAloads_litt    <- data.frame(Variables = rownames(pca_litt$rotation), pca_litt$rotation)

pca_plot_litt <- ggplot(pca_litt_df, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_point(data = pca_litt_df, aes(color = Ecosystem, shape = Plant_type), size = 5, alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ecosystem_colors, name = "Ecosystem") +
  geom_segment(data = PCAloads_litt,
               aes(x = 0, xend = PC1 * 1, y = 0, yend = PC2 * 1),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")), colour = "grey", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = PCAloads_litt,
                             aes(x = PC1 * 1.07, y = PC2 * 1.07, label = Variables),
                             size = 6, colour = "darkblue",
                             label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"), label.size = 0.25) +
  xlab("PC1 (53.47%)") + ylab("PC2 (18.10%)") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title.position = "top"),
         shape = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title = "Plant type")) +
  apatheme + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
pca_plot_litt

ggarrange(pca_plot_litt, pca_litt_contributions_plot, nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 0.5))

ggsave(here::here("plots/PCAs/litter_chem_pca_pH_plant.png"),
       width = 100 * 1.3, height = 100, units = "mm", dpi = 300)

metadata <- metadata |> rownames_to_column("SampleID")
litter_md <- metadata |> filter(str_ends(SampleID, "1|2")) |> column_to_rownames("SampleID")

# PCA on litter-only samples
pca_litt_md <- prcomp(~ pH + crude_protein + cellulose + hemicellulose + lignin,
                      data = litter_md[, c(11, 15:19)], center = T, scale. = T, na.action = na.exclude)
summary(pca_litt_md)

pca_litt_sq_loadings_md   <- pca_litt_md$rotation^2
pca_litt_contributions_md <- sweep(pca_litt_sq_loadings_md, 2, colSums(pca_litt_sq_loadings_md), FUN = "/") * 100
print(pca_litt_contributions_md)

# PERMANOVA
litter_PERMANOVA <- adonis2(
  dist(scale(litter_md[, c(11, 15:17, 19)])) ~ Plant_type,
  data = litter_md, permutations = 999)
litter_PERMANOVA

grass_litter_PERMANOVA <- adonis2(
  dist(scale(litter_md |> dplyr::filter(Litter_type == "G") |> dplyr::select(c(11, 15:17, 19)))) ~ Ecosystem,
  data = litter_md |> dplyr::filter(Litter_type == "G"),
  permutations = 999)
grass_litter_PERMANOVA

# Read PRIMER PERMANOVA variance estimates
litter_PERMANOVA_PRIMER <- read.table(
  here::here("PERMANOVA_litter_chem_VarEstimates.txt"), header = T, sep = "\t") |>
  dplyr::filter(Source != "V(reserve_code)") |>
  mutate(percent = Estimate / sum(Estimate))

pca_litt_contributions_md <- as.data.frame(pca_litt_contributions_md) |>
  rownames_to_column(var = "Variable") |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:6), names_to = "PC", values_to = "Percent")

pca_litt_contributions_plot_md <- pca_litt_contributions_md |>
  filter(PC %in% c("PC1", "PC2")) |>
  mutate(Variable = gsub("_", " ", Variable)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PC, y = Percent, fill = Variable)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#8B4513", "#D2691E", "#F4A460", "#FFD700", "black")) +
  labs(y = "% of variance contribution") +
  apatheme +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())

pca_litt_contributions_plot_md

pca_litt_df_md   <- data.frame(pca_litt_md$x)
pca_litt_df_md   <- merge(pca_litt_df_md, litter_md, by = "row.names", all.x = T)
PCAloads_litt_md <- data.frame(Variables = rownames(pca_litt_md$rotation), pca_litt_md$rotation)

pca_plot_litt_md <- ggplot(pca_litt_df_md, aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_point(data = pca_litt_df, aes(color = Ecosystem, shape = Plant_type), size = 4, alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ecosystem_colors, name = "Ecosystem") +
  geom_segment(data = PCAloads_litt_md,
               aes(x = 0, xend = PC1 * 1, y = 0, yend = PC2 * 1),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "mm")), colour = "grey", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = PCAloads_litt_md,
                            aes(x = PC1 * 1.07, y = PC2 * 1.07,
                                label = gsub("_", " ", Variables)),
                            size = 4, colour = "darkblue", alpha = 0.95, fontface = "bold") +
  xlab("PC1 (53.47%)") + ylab("PC2 (18.10%)") +
  guides(color = "none",
         shape = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title = "Litter type")) +
  apatheme +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.9, 0.85),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.6)),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"), legend.spacing.y = unit(0.15, "cm"),
        legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11))

pca_plot_litt_md

litt_plot_final <- ggarrange(pca_plot_litt_md, pca_litt_contributions_plot_md,
                             nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 0.5),
                             labels = c("1B.1", "1B.2"), hjust = 0, vjust = 1)
litt_plot_final

ggsave(here::here("plots/PCAs/litter_chem_pca_ecosystem.png"),
       width = 220, height = 110, units = "mm", dpi = 300)

# Litter chemistry composition barplot
litter_chem_comp_barplot <- litter_md |>
  group_by(Plant_type) |>
  reframe(
    crude_protein = mean(crude_protein, na.rm = TRUE),
    cellulose     = mean(cellulose,     na.rm = TRUE),
    hemicellulose = mean(hemicellulose, na.rm = TRUE),
    lignin        = mean(lignin,        na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:5), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(variable = gsub("_", " ", variable)) |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable,
                            levels = c("crude protein", "lignin", "hemicellulose", "cellulose"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Plant_type, y = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(x = "Litter Type", y = "% of dry weight content", fill = "Component") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#D2691E", "#FFD700", "#F4A460", "#8B4513")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())

print(litter_chem_comp_barplot)

# Correlation pairs plot
panel_cor_sig <- function(data, mapping, method = "pearson", alpha = 0.05, ...) {
  x  <- GGally::eval_data_col(data, mapping$x)
  y  <- GGally::eval_data_col(data, mapping$y)
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y)
  ct <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = method))
  r  <- unname(ct$estimate); p <- ct$p.value
  lab <- sprintf("%.2f%s", r,
                 ifelse(p < .001, "***", ifelse(p < .01, "**", ifelse(p < .05, "*", ""))))
  sig <- is.finite(p) && p < alpha
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = .5, y = .5, label = lab, size = 5,
             fontface = if (sig) "bold" else "plain",
             colour   = if (sig) "firebrick" else "grey40") +
    theme_void()
}

panel_scatter_sig <- function(data, mapping, method = "lm", alpha = 0.05, ...) {
  x  <- GGally::eval_data_col(data, mapping$x)
  y  <- GGally::eval_data_col(data, mapping$y)
  ok <- stats::complete.cases(x, y)
  p  <- tryCatch(stats::cor.test(x[ok], y[ok])$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  sig <- is.finite(p) && p < alpha
  ggplot(data, mapping) +
    geom_point(size = 1.6, alpha = if (sig) 0.7 else 0.15) +
    geom_smooth(method = method, se = FALSE,
                linewidth = if (sig) 0.9 else 0.4,
                linetype  = if (sig) "solid" else "dashed")
}

GGally::ggpairs(litter_md,
                columns = c("pH", "cellulose", "crude_protein", "hemicellulose", "lignin"),
                lower = list(continuous = panel_scatter_sig),
                upper = list(continuous = panel_cor_sig),
                diag  = list(continuous = GGally::wrap("densityDiag")))

ggsave(here::here("plots/linear_regression/litter_chem_corrplot.png"),
       width = 180, height = 180 * 0.75, units = "mm", dpi = 320)
```
